svg.title: F-02 guide-word scenes
svg.desc: Guide-word scenes for F-02 Detect and track objects. M01 No function: A road user or obstacle in the path is not detected; no deceleration is planned for it (H-02). M02 Stops functioning: Detection stops mid-trip; same as no function (H-02, rated as M01). M03 Unrequested function: A phantom object in the path; the vehicle brakes hard for nothing (H-03). M04 Function stuck: Object list frozen; new road users are missed as in M01 (H-02, rated as M01). M05 Excessive function: Objects larger or closer than they are; unneeded braking as in M03 (H-03, rated as M03). M06 Partial function: Some objects missed or too small; bounded by M01 (H-02, rated as M01). M08 Functions late: Detection late; same as delayed (H-02, rated as M11). M11 Delayed: Detection latency beyond specification; braking starts too late for a road user entering the path (H-02). M12 Inverse function: Velocity direction reversed; a road user moving into the path is taken as leaving it, as in M01 (H-02, rated as M01). M13 Erratic or intermittent: Objects flicker in and out; each false appearance acts as M03 (H-03, rated as M03).
svg.text: F-02 Detect and track objects: what each malfunction does
WP-C-03 §6.1, Figure 6-4 (F-02): the 10 safety-related guide words, 3 rated and 7 folded into another. Schematic, not simulation results.
A road user or obstacle in the path is not detected;
no deceleration is planned for it
Acts at first, then stops while still needed
Detection stops mid-trip; same as no function
A phantom object in the path; the vehicle brakes
Holds its last output and ignores new input
Object list frozen; new road users are missed as in
Objects larger or closer than they are; unneeded
Output smaller than intended but not zero
Some objects missed or too small; bounded by M01
Acts after its trigger has passed
Acts correctly but with latency beyond its specific…
starts too late for a road user entering the path
Acts in the opposite direction or sense
Velocity direction reversed; a road user moving into
the path is taken as leaving it, as in M01
Output oscillates, chatters or comes and goes
Objects flicker in and out; each false appearance
